data.name: Fayzan
data.gender_notes: Fayzan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-y-z', meaning 'to open' or 'to bring success'. In the context of a name, Fayzan is a title given to one who brings victory or success. The name Fayzan carries the meaning “Successor, one who brings victory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fayzan usually hope their child will grow to embody successor, one who brings victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayzan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Fayzan's name serves as a reminder of the divine support and guidance that one can draw upon during challenging times. It emphasizes the importance of seeking Allah's (God's) help and relying on His Mercy to overcome hardships and achieve success, as depicted in Quranic verses like "Allah is With the Patient" (2:45) and "Allah is there for the victors" (61:13). Thus, the name Fayzan carries a profound message of faith and perseverance, encouraging the bearer to remain steadfast and trust in Allah despite life's adversities.
